text.en:
The ceiling prices fixed in this Order include for
salmon the 7 per cent sales tax and 1 per cent munic-
ipal tax and for roasted ground coffee the 17 per cent
special excise tax on foreign exchange, 7 per cent sales tax
and 1 per cent municipal tax.
SEc. 3. This Order shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 21st day of March, in
the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and fifty-two, and
of the Independence of the Philippines, the sixth.
BLPIDIO QUIRINO
President of the Phitippine:
953
By the President:
MARCIANO ROQUE
Acting Executive Secretary
